settings.heading: Slow beauty,
settings.body: Marlowe Botanicals began at a kitchen table with a single bottle of lavender and a stubborn belief that rest shouldn't be a luxury. Every oil, blend, and candle we make still starts there — small, slow, and by hand.

settings.heading: How it started
settings.paragraph_1: After years as a massage therapist, I kept sending clients home wishing they could bottle the calm from the table. So I learned to. First for friends, then a tiny market stall, then this.
settings.paragraph_2: Today every product is blended in small batches, tested on my own tired shoulders, and made with ingredients I can trace back to the grower. No shortcuts, no synthetic fragrance — just plants doing what they do best.

settings.title: Small-batch
settings.text: Made in runs of a few dozen, so quality never gets lost at scale.

settings.title: Ethically sourced
settings.text: Ingredients traced to growers we know, cruelty-free, always.

settings.title: Skin-safe
settings.text: Properly diluted, dermatologist-reviewed, and free of synthetic fragrance.

settings.title: Cruelty-free
settings.text: Never tested on animals — kind to your skin and to them.
breathe deep ✦ rest often ✦ blended by hand ✦ botanicals only

settings.quote: Rest isn't something you earn at the end of the day. It's something you're allowed to reach for any time.

settings.heading: Ready to slow down?
settings.subheading: Marlowe Botanicals is looking forward to helping you relax, rest, and live life to the fullest.
